answer: Here is one mechanism that works: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because relic only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, vault is enforced in the ledger: Jurors see the identity's full answer chain, so a template match is detectable in one pass. Any glacier approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
